 155+ E17B              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 156+ E17B              ; Sound effects. The game asks for one with PlaySFX id (Macros: SoundFxPending[id] = 1, a single store so it is safe
 157+ E17B              ; against this interrupt); each interrupt SfxStartPending starts every pending one on a free channel and SfxStepChannels
 158+ E17B              ; plays one step (tone period and volume) of every running one, so a step is a frame. Channels: AY1 B and C, AY2 A B C,
 159+ E17B              ; AY3 A B C (AY1 A is the engine, UpdateEngineSound). Tones only: InitAudio's mixer has the noise off. A request with
 160+ E17B              ; every channel busy is dropped. (This replaces EnqueSound / PlaySound, whose register numbers were only right for
 161+ E17B              ; channel A, whose channel map had 6 entries for 8 channels, and which nothing ever asked for a sound)
 162+ E17B              SfxChannels             equ 8
 163+ E17B FD           SfxChannelChip:         DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY1
 164+ E17C FD                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY1
 165+ E17D FE                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY2
 166+ E17E FE                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY2
 167+ E17F FE                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY2
 168+ E180 FF                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY3
 169+ E181 FF                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY3
 170+ E182 FF                                   DB      TURBO_MANDATORY | TURBO_LEFT | TURBO_RIGHT | TURBO_CHIP_AY3
 171+ E183 01 02 00 01  SfxChannelVoice:        DB      1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2              ; A = 0, B = 1, C = 2
 171+ E187 02 00 01 02
 172+ E18B 00 00 00...  SfxChannelLeft:         DS      SfxChannels                         ; steps still to play, 0 = free
 173+ E193 00 00 00...  SfxChannelPtr:          DS      SfxChannels * 2                     ; the next step, 0 once silenced
 174+ E1A3 00 00 00...  SfxChannelSilence:      DS      SfxChannels                         ; non 0: the effect just ended, set the volume to 0
 175+ E1AB
 176+ E1AB              ; d = register, a = value on the chip already selected; uses bc
 177+ E1AB 01 FD FF     SfxWriteReg:            ld      bc,TURBO_SOUND_NEXT_CONTROL
 178+ E1AE ED 51                                out     (c),d
 179+ E1B0 06 BF                                ld      b,$BF
 180+ E1B2 ED 79                                out     (c),a
 181+ E1B4 C9                                   ret
 182+ E1B5
 183+ E1B5              ; e = channel: select its chip, d = its voice (0 to 2); uses a, bc, hl
 184+ E1B5 21 7B E1     SfxSelectChannel:       ld      hl,SfxChannelChip

 196+ E1C9              ; start every requested effect (SoundFxPending, main memory)
 197+ E1C9 21 A5 85     SfxStartPending:        ld      hl,SoundFxPending
 198+ E1CC 0E 00                                ld      c,0                                 ; c = effect id
 199+ E1CE 7E           .Loop:                  ld      a,(hl)
 200+ E1CF A7                                   and     a
 201+ E1D0 28 0A                                jr      z,.Next
 202+ E1D2 36 00                                ld      (hl),0
 203+ E1D4 C5 E5                                push    bc,,hl
 204+ E1D6 79                                   ld      a,c
 205+ E1D7 CD E4 E1                             call    SfxStart
 206+ E1DA E1 C1                                pop     bc,,hl
 207+ E1DC 23           .Next:                  inc     hl
 208+ E1DD 0C                                   inc     c
 209+ E1DE 79                                   ld      a,c
 210+ E1DF FE 07                                cp      SFXCount
 211+ E1E1 38 EB                                jr      c,.Loop
 212+ E1E3 C9                                   ret

 214+ E1E4              ; a = effect id: on the first free channel (dropped if none)
 215+ E1E4 21 89 E4     SfxStart:               ld      hl,SFXPointerList                   ; de = its data
 216+ E1E7 87                                   add     a,a
 217+ E1E8 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 218+ E1EA 5E                                   ld      e,(hl)
 219+ E1EB 23                                   inc     hl
 220+ E1EC 56                                   ld      d,(hl)
 221+ E1ED 21 8B E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelLeft                   ; find a free channel
 222+ E1F0 06 08                                ld      b,SfxChannels
 223+ E1F2 0E 00                                ld      c,0
 224+ E1F4 7E           .Find:                  ld      a,(hl)
 225+ E1F5 A7                                   and     a
 226+ E1F6 28 05                                jr      z,.Found
 227+ E1F8 23                                   inc     hl
 228+ E1F9 0C                                   inc     c
 229+ E1FA 10 F8                                djnz    .Find
 230+ E1FC C9                                   ret                                         ; all busy
 231+ E1FD 1A           .Found:                 ld      a,(de)                              ; the step count
 232+ E1FE 77                                   ld      (hl),a
 233+ E1FF 13                                   inc     de                                  ; the first step
 234+ E200 21 93 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelPtr
 235+ E203 79                                   ld      a,c
 236+ E204 87                                   add     a,a
 237+ E205 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 238+ E207 73                                   ld      (hl),e
 239+ E208 23                                   inc     hl
 240+ E209 72                                   ld      (hl),d
 241+ E20A 21 A3 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelSilence
 242+ E20D 79                                   ld      a,c
 243+ E20E ED 31                                add     hl,a
 244+ E210 36 00                                ld      (hl),0
 245+ E212 C9                                   ret
 246+ E213
 247+ E213              ; one step of every running effect, and silence the ones that ended last frame
 248+ E213 1E 00        SfxStepChannels:        ld      e,0                                 ; e = channel
 249+ E215 21 A3 E1     .Loop:                  ld      hl,SfxChannelSilence
 250+ E218 7B                                   ld      a,e
 251+ E219 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 252+ E21B 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 253+ E21C A7                                   and     a
 254+ E21D 28 0F                                jr      z,.NotEnded
 255+ E21F 36 00                                ld      (hl),0
 256+ E221 D5                                   push    de
 257+ E222 CD B5 E1                             call    SfxSelectChannel
 258+ E225 7A                                   ld      a,d                                 ; volume register 8 + voice
 259+ E226 C6 08                                add     a,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 260+ E228 57                                   ld      d,a
 261+ E229 AF                                   xor     a
 262+ E22A CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 263+ E22D D1                                   pop     de
 264+ E22E 21 8B E1     .NotEnded:              ld      hl,SfxChannelLeft
 265+ E231 7B                                   ld      a,e
 266+ E232 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 267+ E234 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 268+ E235 A7                                   and     a
 269+ E236 28 4B                                jr      z,.Next                             ; free
 270+ E238 35                                   dec     (hl)                                ; one fewer to play
 271+ E239 20 08                                jr      nz,.Step
 272+ E23B 21 A3 E1                             ld      hl,SfxChannelSilence                ; the last: silence it next frame
 273+ E23E 7B                                   ld      a,e
 274+ E23F ED 31                                add     hl,a
 275+ E241 36 01                                ld      (hl),1
 276+ E243 21 93 E1     .Step:                  ld      hl,SfxChannelPtr                    ; ix = the step's data
 277+ E246 7B                                   ld      a,e
 278+ E247 87                                   add     a,a
 279+ E248 ED 31                                add     hl,a
 280+ E24A E5                                   push    hl
 281+ E24B 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)
 282+ E24C 23                                   inc     hl
 283+ E24D 66                                   ld      h,(hl)
 284+ E24E 6F                                   ld      l,a
 285+ E24F E5                                   push    hl
 286+ E250 DD E1                                pop     ix
 287+ E252 D5                                   push    de
 288+ E253 CD B5 E1                             call    SfxSelectChannel                    ; d = voice
 289+ E256 7A                                   ld      a,d                                 ; fine tone register 2 * voice
 290+ E257 87                                   add     a,a
 291+ E258 57                                   ld      d,a
 292+ E259 DD 7E 00                             ld      a,(ix+SFXFineOffset)
 293+ E25C CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 294+ E25F 14                                   inc     d                                   ; coarse 2 * voice + 1
 295+ E260 DD 7E 01                             ld      a,(ix+SFXCorseOffset)
 296+ E263 E6 0F                                and     $0F
 297+ E265 CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 298+ E268 CB 3A                                srl     d                                   ; volume 8 + voice
 299+ E26A 7A                                   ld      a,d
 300+ E26B C6 08                                add     a,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 301+ E26D 57                                   ld      d,a
 302+ E26E DD 7E 02                             ld      a,(ix+SFXVolOffset)
 303+ E271 E6 0F                                and     $0F
 304+ E273 CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg
 305+ E276 D1                                   pop     de
 306+ E277 E1                                   pop     hl                                  ; the pointer on a step
 307+ E278 01 03 00                             ld      bc,SFXBlockLength
 308+ E27B DD 09                                add     ix,bc
 309+ E27D DD E5                                push    ix
 310+ E27F C1                                   pop     bc
 311+ E280 71                                   ld      (hl),c
 312+ E281 23                                   inc     hl
 313+ E282 70                                   ld      (hl),b
 314+ E283 1C           .Next:                  inc     e
 315+ E284 7B                                   ld      a,e
 316+ E285 FE 08                                cp      SfxChannels
 317+ E287 38 8C                                jr      c,.Loop
 318+ E289 C9                                   ret

 324+ E291 23                                   inc     hl
 325+ E292 10 FB                                djnz    .Clear
 326+ E294 1E 00                                ld      e,0
 327+ E296 D5           .Silence:               push    de
 328+ E297 CD B5 E1                             call    SfxSelectChannel
 329+ E29A 7A                                   ld      a,d
 330+ E29B C6 08                                add     a,CHANNEL_A_AMPLITUDE
 331+ E29D 57                                   ld      d,a
 332+ E29E AF                                   xor     a
 333+ E29F CD AB E1                             call    SfxWriteReg

 339+ E2A9 C9                                   ret

   1+ 0000              ; AHL = BHL + CDE, 24 bit lead sign (S15.8: bit 7 of B/C is the sign, the other 23 bits the magnitude).
   2+ 0000              ; Same signs add the magnitudes (the sign in bit 7 of B carries through), opposite signs subtract the smaller
   3+ 0000              ; magnitude from the larger and take that operand's sign. Never returns -0, overflow is not detected.
   4+ 0000              ; Destroys C and DE.

 114+ 08AE              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ 08AE              ; Ship version of ApplyMyRollAndPitchIX with an extra fraction byte per axis.
 116+ 08AE              ; With roll / pitch rates of only 1..2 / 256 per frame, alpha * x truncated to whole raw units is 0 for any |x| below
 117+ 08AE              ; 128..256 raw, so nearby ships close to the centre of view never moved when the player rolled. Here each axis is
 118+ 08AE              ; worked as a 32 bit 2's complement value (raw * 256 + fraction) and the fraction is kept between frames.
 119+ 08AE              ; Products are truncated towards zero so the Minsky rotation has no drift in either direction.
 120+ 08AE              ; ix = 24 bit lead sign position (x, y, z each lo, hi, sign), iy = 3 fraction bytes (x, y, z). ix and iy preserved
 121+ 08AE              ; Its work variables (RPX32 .. RPSign) are in general_variables.asm, not here: this bank is in slot 0 and writes to
 122+ 08AE              ; $0000-$3FFF can be going to layer 2, so variables in this bank read back as garbage
 123+ 08AE
 124+ 08AE              ; 32 bit 2's complement value at dest = position axis at ix+ixoff (lo, hi, sign) * 256 + fraction at iy+iyoff
 125+ 08AE              RPLoadAxis:                 MACRO   dest, ixoff, iyoff
 126+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(iy+iyoff)
 127+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest),a
 128+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff)
 129+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest+1),a
 130+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff+1)
 131+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest+2),a
 132+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff+2)
 133+ 08AE ~                                        ld      b,a
 134+ 08AE ~                                        and     $7F
 135+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest+3),a
 136+ 08AE ~                                        bit     7,b
 137+ 08AE ~                                        jr      z,.Positive
 138+ 08AE ~                                        ld      hl,dest
 139+ 08AE ~                                        call    RPNeg32
 140+ 08AE ~            .Positive:
 141+ 08AE                                          ENDM
 142+ 08AE
 143+ 08AE              ; position axis at ix+ixoff and fraction at iy+iyoff = 32 bit 2's complement value at src (src is left as |src|)
 144+ 08AE              RPSaveAxis:                 MACRO   src, ixoff, iyoff

 212+ 0A13              ; RPProd = (hl) * a / 256, (hl) = 32 bit 2's complement, a = lead sign S7 rotator, truncated towards zero

   1+ 0B1E              ; Updates compass based on vertex positions in IX
   2+ 0B1E              ; IX structure is3 x 24 bit (x, y, z) followed by two 16t bit Compass X, Y
   3+ 0B1E              ; compas range is +-14 so we scale to +-16 and if result (or result + 1) has bit 5 set then clamp to 14 +-
   4+ 0B1E              ; Compass position is based on the normals for position relative to player scaled to +/- 16
   5+ 0B1E
   6+ 0B1E              ; For Normal to compass we take the leading sign Normal in BC as the basis
   7+ 0B1E              ; as its not 2's compliment. The result is a
   8+ 0B1E
   9+ 0B1E              ; When written to compass position its a 2's compliment +/- 12
  10+ 0B1E              ; Takes bc = Normal and returns HL with 2's compliment offset +/-12, uses DE

   1+ 0DA8              ; ix = pointer to orientation matrix, each value a 16 bit lead sign word with 1.0 = $6000 (96 in the hi byte)
   2+ 0DA8              ; ix data structure needs to be
   3+ 0DA8              ;       X          y            Z
   4+ 0DA8              ; side +00 , +01   +02 , +03    +04 , +05
   5+ 0DA8              ; roof +06 , +07   +08 , +09    +10 , +11
   6+ 0DA8              ; nose +12 , +13   +14 , +15    +16 , +17
   7+ 0DA8              ;
   8+ 0DA8              ; Re-orthonormalises the matrix against drift (Elite TIDY), working on the hi bytes as Normalise16IX does:
   9+ 0DA8              ;   1. nose = nose / |nose|
  10+ 0DA8              ;   2. make roof perpendicular to nose: pick the nose axis k with the largest |nose_k| (>= 96/sqrt(3) once normalised,
  11+ 0DA8              ;      so the divide is well conditioned and roof moves the least) and set roof_k = -(nose_a * roof_a + nose_b * roof_b) / nose_k
  12+ 0DA8              ;   3. roof = roof / |roof|
  13+ 0DA8              ;   4. side = (nose x roof) / 96, then side = side / |side|
  14+ 0DA8              ; ix is preserved, uses the banked maths routines so MathsBankedFns must be paged in

   1+ 0EBE              ; fast 16-bit isqrt by Zeda Thomas
   2+ 0EBE              ;Feel free to use for whatever :)
   3+ 0EBE
   4+ 0EBE              sqrtHL:
   5+ 0EBE              ;Input: HL
   6+ 0EBE              ;Output: A is the integer square root of HL
   7+ 0EBE              ;Destroys: HL,DE (D is actually 0)
   8+ 0EBE              ;min: 343cc
   9+ 0EBE              ;max: 380cc
  10+ 0EBE              ;avg: 361.5cc
  11+ 0EBE              ;88 bytes
  12+ 0EBE 11 40 50                             ld de,05040h                ; 10
  13+ 0EC1 7C                                   ld a,h                      ; 4
  14+ 0EC2 93                                   sub e                       ; 4
  15+ 0EC3 30 03                                jr nc,sq7                   ;\
  16+ 0EC5 83                                   add a,e                     ; | branch 1: 12cc
  17+ 0EC6 16 10                                ld d,16                     ; | branch 2: 18cc
  18+ 0EC8 BA           sq7:                    cp d                        ; 4
  19+ 0EC9 38 03                                jr c,sq6                    ;\
  20+ 0ECB 92                                   sub d                       ; | branch 1: 12cc
  21+ 0ECC CB EA                                set 5,d                     ; | branch 2: 19cc
  22+ 0ECE CB A2        sq6:                    res 4,d                     ; 8
  23+ 0ED0 CB 3A                                srl d                       ; 8
  24+ 0ED2 CB D2                                set 2,d                     ; 8

  26+ 0ED5 38 03                                jr c,sq5                    ;\
  27+ 0ED7 92                                   sub d                       ; | branch 1: 12cc
  28+ 0ED8 CB DA                                set 3,d                     ; | branch 2: 19cc

  30+ 0EDC 3C                                   inc a                       ; 4

  32+ 0EDE 30 03                                jr nc,sq4                   ;\
  33+ 0EE0 15                                   dec d                       ; | branch 1: 12cc
  34+ 0EE1 82                                   add a,d                     ; | branch 2: 19cc
  35+ 0EE2 15                                   dec d                       ; | <-- this resets the low bit of D, so `srl d` resets carry.
  36+ 0EE3 CB 3A        sq4:                     srl d                      ; 8
  37+ 0EE5 67                                   ld h,a                      ; 4
  38+ 0EE6 7B                                   ld a,e                      ; 4
  39+ 0EE7 ED 52                                sbc hl,de                   ; 15
  40+ 0EE9 30 01                                jr nc,sq3                   ;\
  41+ 0EEB 19                                   add hl,de                   ; | 12cc or 18cc

  43+ 0EED 1F                                   rra                         ; 4
  44+ 0EEE CB 3A                                srl d                       ; 8

  69+ 0F6C              ;-- checks to see if a postition is in range of another, e.g. missile hit
  70+ 0F6C              ;-- ix = ship position    - pointer to S15.8 xyz vector as 3 bytes per element (lo, hi, sign)
  71+ 0F6C              ;-- iy = missile position - pointer to S15.8 xyz vector as 3 bytes per element
  72+ 0F6C              ;-- sets carry if |ix - iy| < CurrentMissileBlastRange (1/256ths, 0.0 to 0.996) on every axis, else not carry
  73+ 0F6C              ;-- AddBCHtoDELsigned does not detect overflow: with opposite signs |ix| + |iy| >= 32768.0 carries into the sign bit and
  74+ 0F6C              ;-- could look close. That needs one of them >= 16384.0 (sign byte bit 6) and the distance is then far beyond any blast
  75+ 0F6C              ;-- range, so opposite signs with bit 6 set in either is treated as out of range. ix and iy are advanced by 9 on a hit
  76+ 0F6C 06 03        CheckInCollisionRange:  ld      b,3
  77+ 0F6E C5           .AxisLoop:              push    bc
  78+ 0F6F DD 7E 02                             ld      a,(ix+2)            ; opposite signs?
  79+ 0F72 FD AE 02                             xor     (iy+2)              ; .
  80+ 0F75 F2 82 0F                             jp      p,.NoOverflow       ; .
  81+ 0F78 DD 7E 02                             ld      a,(ix+2)            ; and either >= 16384.0
  82+ 0F7B FD B6 02                             or      (iy+2)              ; .
  83+ 0F7E E6 40                                and     $40                 ; .
  84+ 0F80 20 1C                                jr      nz,.NoCollisionPop  ; then too far apart (and the subtract could overflow)
  85+ 0F82 CD DA 00     .NoOverflow:            call    SubDELequAtIXMinusAtIY24Signed ; del = ix - iy, S15.8
  86+ 0F85 7A                                   ld      a,d                 ; integer bits 8-14 set

  88+ 0F88 B3                                   or      e                   ; or integer bits 0-7

  90+ 0F8B 7D                                   ld      a,l                 ; fraction
  91+ 0F8C 21 C6 86                             ld      hl,CurrentMissileBlastRange
  92+ 0F8F BE                                   cp      (hl)

  94+ 0F92 C1                                   pop     bc
  95+ 0F93 11 03 00                             ld      de,3                ; next axis

  97+ 0F98 FD 19                                add     iy,de               ; .
  98+ 0F9A 10 D2                                djnz    .AxisLoop
